overall_summary: The resume provides strong, specific evidence in document retrieval, source-grounded answering, retrieval evaluation, Python services, and document-system lifecycle design. Dev has worked with changing document collections, context-preserving preparation, lexical and semantic retrieval approaches, cited source sections, incremental updates, and structured failure analysis. The resume provides limited evidence about broader AI/ML or LLM fundamentals and does not establish agentic AI or AI security experience, so those areas should be explored in the interview.
